<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def slotmask(frame,slot,r0=49,r1=58,c0=14,c1=49):
    rows=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cols=sorted(set(c for c in range(c0,c1) for r in range(r0,r1) if rows[r][c]=='B'))
    groups=[];cur=[cols[0]]
    for c in cols[1:]:
        if c-cur[-1]<=1: cur.append(c)
        else: groups.append(cur);cur=[c]
    groups.append(cur)
    g=groups[slot]
    a,b=min(g),max(g)
    return tuple(''.join('#' if rows[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(a,b+1)) for r in range(r0,r1) if any(rows[r][c]=='B' for c in g))
def cur():
    rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for r in range(46,64):
        for c in range(64):
            if rows[r][c]=='W': return (r,c)
# move to slot 0
cp=cur()
print("start cursor",cp)
if cp[1]!=15:
    action(['LEFT']); print("after LEFT",cur())
start=slotmask(current_frame,0)
seq=[start]
for i in range(14):
    action(['UP'])
    m=slotmask(current_frame,0)
    seq.append(m)
    if m==start:
        print("cycle closed after",i+1,"UPs"); break
print("distinct in seq:",len(set(seq)),"total",len(seq))
for j,m in enumerate(seq):
    seen='*' if m in seq[:j] else ' '
    print(j,seen)
    for r in m: print('   ',r)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def slotmask(frame,slot,r0=49,r1=58,c0=14,c1=49):
    rows=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cols=sorted(set(c for c in range(c0,c1) for r in range(r0,r1) if rows[r][c]=='B'))
    groups=[];cur=[cols[0]]
    for c in cols[1:]:
        if c-cur[-1]<=1: cur.append(c)
        else: groups.append(cur);cur=[c]
    groups.append(cur)
    g=groups[slot]
    a,b=min(g),max(g)
    return tuple(''.join('#' if rows[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(a,b+1)) for r in range(r0,r1) if any(rows[r][c]=='B' for c in g))
